churn_resistance.rationale: Strong: one data-access module, typed API boundaries, one URL builder, and no framework internals or generated boilerplate, so a Hono v5 or htmx 4 upgrade would touch almost nothing. Docked one point for the four-way duplication of the English-name rule and a couple of hand-built URL/constants that a spec change would have to chase.

findings.issue: The English-name display rule (names.find(n => n.language.name === 'en')) is re-implemented inline at index.tsx:55, 73, 79 and 88 even though api.ts:160 already exports englishName() for it.
findings.suggestion: Use the englishName helper in all four handlers so the display-name rule lives in one place.

findings.issue: The moves-fragment URL is constructed twice by string concatenation (redirect at :62 and HX-Push-Url at :66); a change to the query/anchor scheme must be made in both.
findings.suggestion: Extract a movesUrl(speciesName, game) helper next to homeUrl() and use it for both the redirect and the push header.

findings.issue: Cache eviction is insertion-order FIFO (cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value!)) with no touch-on-read, so under pressure it evicts hot entries as readily as cold ones.
findings.suggestion: Delete-and-re-set the entry on read (or cap by staleness) so eviction approximates LRU and hot species survive.

findings.issue: MAX_STAT = 255 (and METHOD_ORDER at :31) are presentation constants hardcoded in the view file, detached from the data layer that owns API knowledge.
findings.suggestion: Move them next to STAT_LABELS in a shared constants module or derive from the data layer, so a stats-visual change doesn't require touching the component.

findings.issue: getDex() reconstructs each species' type slots from every /type resource's pokemon list rather than from the Pokémon resource itself; if the API's cross-references lag the Pokémon resource, home-page type badges silently go missing.
findings.suggestion: Prefer the default Pokémon's own types (types endpoint per species, cached) or document the assumption next to the code.

findings.issue: htmx is pinned to ^2.0.11 while htmx 4.0.0 shipped on 2026-08-28; 2.x is deliberately still npm 'latest', and the attributes this app uses (hx-get/target/swap/trigger/sync, HX-Push-Url) carry over unchanged, so this is fine today but is the one dependency with a visible next major.
findings.suggestion: Keep the pin; when 4.x becomes npm-latest, upgrade in one place (the copy script + Layout script tag) after checking the 4.x notes.

summary: This code is on the current stable generation of everything it touches — Hono 4.13.14 with async JSX server components, @hono/node-server 2.1.5, htmx 2.x — and reaches for the platform (native fetch, streams cancellation, URLSearchParams, import.meta.dirname) instead of dependencies, with a lean three-package runtime footprint. Data access sits behind one typed module and URL building behind one helper, so framework or requirement changes would touch few files. The only real blemishes are a duplicated English-name rule across four handlers, a twice-built moves URL, and a couple of hardcoded view constants.
